observations.behavior: Adds a loadAll prop and its value into the kea logic's unique key, separating full-list requests from paginated search requests.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows GitHub repository pickers for Business Knowledge or other workflows that require loading every repo without pagination while keeping concurrent search pickers independent.

observations.behavior: Changes page-loading behavior so that when loadAll is true, the component remains in a loading state between pages rather than immediately showing results after the first page.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports use cases where users expect an exhaustive repository list before proceeding, preventing premature completion of selection flows.

observations.behavior: Increases backend limit on selectable repositories from 20 to 100 across business knowledge settings and API schemas.
observations.posthog_connection: Relaxes constraints allowing larger account selections; relevant for teams with many GitHub installations needing broader access.

observations.limitations: Only frontend and backend configuration changes are shown. No tests demonstrate failure recovery, no shared dependency compatibility checks, and no migration or rollout strategy.

review.limitations: Only frontend and backend configuration changes are shown. No tests demonstrate failure recovery, no shared dependency compatibility checks, and no migration or rollout strategy.
review.reason: Adds bounded capability (loadAll) and raises limits, but lacks systemic risk reduction or cross-component implementation evidence.
review.posthog_relevance: Could support warehouse or MCP connectors requiring full repository lists, though adoption and benefit remain unverified.
review.uncertainty: No complete end-to-end test or production deployment context.
